checkpoints.description: [1/3] Planning and impact assessment for Aegean-E profile and AIKit integration

impact_assessment.why: Aegean-E is the GitHub profile repository for the account, housing the user's public profile and sponsorship config. It was missing local git tracking, AIKit memory, cold-start documentation, and Phase 4 delivery verification.
impact_assessment.benefits: Connects the profile repository to the AIKit cockpit, provides full cold-start and navigation quick references, adheres to AIKit hygiene and guidelines gates, and ensures clean delivery.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (profile markdown and metadata only); dependency: none (standard library / 0 deps); concurrency: single agent operation; state: additive .aikit memory files.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep profile content faithful to the rewritten version, add navigation and cold-start reference cleanly at the bottom, and run all built-in Phase 4 gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Integrated AIKit memory, tests, cold-start docs, and passed Phase 4 verification gates (checklists: passed)
[1/3] Plan: rename project to AegeanWorks and rebuild the profile around verified public repos

impact_assessment.why: The account is AegeanWorks; the profile folder, links, funding and licence doc still used Aegean-E and the README listed no public-repo guarantee.
impact_assessment.benefits: One identity across folder, links, badges and licence; an original banner; a 33-repo public atlas enforced by a test allowlist.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: README structure gated by AIKit; dependency: none, stdlib only; concurrency: single agent; state: additive banner asset and one ADR
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the Cold-Start Quick Reference structure the README gate requires, verify every link live and rerun all four gates before the commit

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Built banner, README atlas, rebrand and tests; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets 4/4; 7 project tests; 34 README links live)
[1/4] Plan: static responsive company site in docs/ plus a company-voice profile rewrite

impact_assessment.why: AegeanWorks has no web presence beyond GitHub; the profile also speaks as one person while the brand now presents as a company.
impact_assessment.benefits: A fast zero-dependency Pages site that presents the studio and its 33 public projects, warm company copy, and no build step.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GitHub Pages serves docs/ from main; dependency: none, no external fonts or CDNs; concurrency: single agent; state: new docs/ tree and README tree update
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep all assets local, respect reduced motion, verify contrast, screenshot desktop and mobile, and rerun the four AIKit gates
